mission.description: Fly from the base at (-29304, 4555) to the destination at (10937, -3577). The route must pass through the required points A (Denham Aerodrome) at (-18209, 9818), B (Chipstead Private Airstrip) at (5806, -23237); visit A before B. Maintain an altitude between 20 and 120 meters at every waypoint. Avoid all restricted zones and obstacles (Z1 [RAF Northolt (EGWU, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z2 [London Heathrow Airport (EGLL, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z3 [London City Airport (EGLC, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z4 [London Biggin Hill Airport (EGKB, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]), including the straight paths between waypoints. Keep the total horizontal route length at or below 110674 meters. (START is Windsor/Ascot Heliport; DEST is King's College Hospital Helipad.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
